Experience supporting commercial sales teams in a B2B environment.

Experience with Monday.com.
Experience with project management.

At Element, we recognize our team's efforts with a competitive compensation package and benefits that go beyond legal requirements:

title: Digital Media Executive Sr.
description:
About the job

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una agencia global de medios, marketing y comunicación que trabaja con algunas de las marcas más importantes del mundo. Combinamos estrategia, innovación, tecnología y análisis para desarrollar soluciones de comunicación que generan resultados de negocio y construyen conexiones relevantes entre las marcas y sus audiencias.




Objetivo de la posición

Brindar soporte estratégico y operativo en la planeación, implementación, optimización y análisis de campañas digitales, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de negocio del cliente, una correcta ejecución de medios y la generación de recomendaciones que contribuyan al desempeño de las campañas.




Principales actividades

• Participar en la planeación y desarrollo de estrategias de medios digitales alineadas a los objetivos del cliente.

• Coordinar la implementación de campañas en diferentes plataformas digitales.

• Dar seguimiento al desempeño de campañas y analizar métricas clave para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

• Elaborar reportes, análisis de resultados y presentaciones ejecutivas para clientes y equipos internos.

• Monitorear presupuestos, pacing y cumplimiento de objetivos de campaña.

• Colaborar con equipos de estrategia, analytics, operaciones y cuentas para garantizar una correcta ejecución.

• Realizar análisis de audiencias, competencia y tendencias digitales para enriquecer las recomendaciones estratégicas.

• Mantener comunicación constante con clientes, partners y stakeholders internos.

• Asegurar la calidad de la ejecución y el cumplimiento de los entregables dentro de los tiempos establecidos.




Requisitos

• Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Publicidad, Negocios o afín.

• Experiencia de 2 a 4 años en agencias de medios digitales o publicidad.

• Conocimiento en plataformas de medios digitales como Meta Ads, Google Ads, DV360, CM360, TikTok Ads o similares.

• Experiencia en seguimiento, optimización y análisis de campañas digitales.

• Conocimiento de métricas de performance, branding y medios digitales.

• Manejo intermedio o avanzado de Excel y PowerPoint.

• Experiencia en elaboración de reportes y presentaciones para clientes.

description:
About the job

Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern | Fluent English required

Salary: $900 to $1400 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:




80% Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Your primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.




20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business Support

We're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.




Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.




We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.
Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.




6) Onboarding Support

Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.
Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.
Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.
Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.




7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional Projects

When recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.
Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.

There are DTC brands that treat TikTok Shop as a side channel, and others that see it for what it actually is: the single highest-leverage lever in the business. This is the second kind. A family puzzle and games company that's found real traction on paid social in a category most competitors still run through wholesale, and is now betting that a small group of the right creators can take it to a category-defining scale.




Right now, TikTok Shop and creator and affiliate relationships are being managed reactively, alongside everything else. The goal with this hire is to change that: find, sign, train, and run the handful of creators who actually move the needle, and turn that into a repeatable engine feeding both TikTok Shop and Meta.




The math is simple, and the opportunity is real. One or two strong creators are already driving outsized results. The plan is to get to 50 of them, fed with great scripts, trained, motivated, and incentivized to keep posting, producing 1,000+ high-quality videos a month between them. That volume, repurposed into Meta ads, is the single biggest unlock this company has in front of it right now.




If you've run a large TikTok Shop from the inside, you know what separates a creator who posts once and disappears from one who becomes a real growth partner, and you're relentless about finding and developing the latter. This is the most important hire this company is making right now.




This is a fully remote, full-time role.

Own the entire creator and affiliate function. Full autonomy over sourcing, negotiating, onboarding, and roster management. This is a build-from-scratch seat, not a maintenance role.

Work with a proven playbook, not a hypothesis. The one or two creators already driving results prove the model works. Your job is to find the next 48, not invent the concept from zero.
A role built around shared upside. The structure is designed so your success and the program's GMV growth move together.




WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO

This role has two connected mandates. The primary one is building and running the creator and affiliate engine behind TikTok Shop, growing from a couple of proven creators to a roster of 50 who are consistently posting high-quality, high-performing content. The second is driving organic social output, high-volume content and video aimed purely at impressions and brand exposure, independent of the GMV-driving creator program.




You will:

Run mass outreach to identify, recruit, and sign TikTok Shop creators and affiliates, treating sourcing as a high-volume, ongoing pipeline rather than a one-time push
Evaluate creators quickly and accurately, knowing within a conversation or two who has the instincts, work ethic, and audience fit to become a real partner versus who's a one-off

Drive organic social output across brand channels as a separate lever from the creator and GMV program, pushing high volume of content purely for reach and impressions at effectively zero media cost




WHO YOU ARE

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.
Ability to work on multiple projects and tools, and switch context in between them.

skills: Define the strategy for your products or programs. Identify the passenger needs and business opportunities they should address, establish clear objectives, and develop a roadmap in partnership with relevant teams.

Own performance for your passenger cohort. Monitor retention, ride frequency, engagement, and program adoption. Analyze user behavior and market trends to understand changes, identify gaps, and recommend actions that strengthen competitive positioning.

Develop business cases and prioritize opportunities. Size the potential impact of new initiatives, estimate costs and expected returns, and articulate the assumptions and tradeoffs behind investment decisions.

Translate insights into product improvements. Combine quantitative analysis, passenger feedback, and research to identify opportunities across the passenger journey. Partner with Product and Design to turn those opportunities into clear requirements and experiences.

Lead cross-functional execution. Align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Operations, CX, Marketplace, and BI on priorities, scope, timelines, and success metrics. Surface dependencies and risks early and keep initiatives moving from concept through launch.

Design and evaluate experiments. Develop hypotheses, partner on A/B tests or pilots, and assess whether initiatives generate incremental improvements in retention and frequency. Use the findings to recommend what to scale, refine, or stop.
Communicate results and recommendations. Turn complex analyses into clear narratives for stakeholders and leadership, explaining what happened, why it matters, and what should happen next.

2–4 years of relevant experience in product analytics, growth, business operations, strategy, loyalty, consulting, or a related role, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical capabilities. Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to clearly communicate insights to both technical and business stakeholders.

Experience with experimentation. Working knowledge of A/B testing, hypothesis development, and experiment interpretation, including the ability to distinguish observed changes from incremental impact.

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to build alignment across teams, influence without formal authority, and present clear recommendations supported by evidence.

Experience in a technology company, particularly a marketplace, mobility, delivery, e-commerce, or consumer subscription business.

Familiarity with marketplace dynamics and how passenger incentives can affect demand, service availability, and profitability.
Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience evaluating unit economics and the financial sustainability of customer-facing programs.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans


Strategy & Execution


Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Senior Product Analytics Analyst
skills: Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as an embedded analytics partner to product squads, collaborating on roadmap prioritization, scoping analytical approaches, and communicating findings in clear, actionable ways.

Product & Funnel Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analyses into user behavior, adoption, engagement, and retention across Mindbody's product surface. Identify trends, friction points, and opportunities that inform product prioritization.
Strategic Analysis: Partner with product leadership on structured, insight-driven analyses for high-priority questions, synthesizing data into clear business recommendations.

Workflow Telemetry & Data Instrumentation: Own the reliability of our product event tracking end to end. Map the core jobs-to-be-done in the Mindbody product, define what needs to be measured to know whether customers complete them, and partner with Engineering and BI to get accurate, scalable event data in place. Turn that foundation into analysis and insight on where customers succeed, stall, or drop off.

AI-Enabled Analysis: Build and leverage AI tools, skills, and agents to accelerate analysis — automating repetitive data work, speeding up exploration, and reaching reliable insight faster. Help raise the bar for how the whole team applies AI to data problems.

Metrics & Dashboards: Define and maintain the north star metrics and KPIs for each product squad, aligned to broader business goals. Partner with BI on long-term, centralized dashboards, and build lightweight reporting views where needed to support fast-moving product work.
Experimentation: Help build our experimentation practice — designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests where they add value, and strengthening the team's testing culture over time.
Data Advocacy: Promote data literacy across the Product org and help PMs and designers develop habits of evidence-based decision-making.

An Experienced Analyst: 2 to 5 years in product analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related analytical role at a B2B or SaaS technology company. Experience partnering closely with Product teams is a strong plus.

Technically Strong: Advanced SQL skills required; experience with dbt or cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) preferred. Hands-on experience with product analytics tools such as Pendo, Mixpanel, or Heap. Proficiency with BI and visualization tools like Looker, Sigma, or Tableau. Familiarity with Python or R a plus.

A Clear Communicator: You translate complex data into crisp, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences. You're comfortable presenting to senior leadership and writing recommendations that drive decisions.

AI-Forward: You actively build and use AI tools, skills, and agents to accelerate your work — not occasionally, but as a core part of how you operate. You've applied AI to real data and analysis problems and can point to where it made you faster or sharper.
A Strong Collaborator: You build relationships across functions and are at your best when working in close partnership with PMs, designers, engineers, and data peers.
Adaptable and Self-Directed: You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You manage competing priorities with good judgment and an ownership mentality.
Comfortable with Experimentation: You understand the fundamentals of A/B testing and experiment design, and are excited to help grow our experimentation practice as the team matures.

We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.

The Team

Mindbody has a complex suite of products and features that customers rely on to run and grow their businesses. As the platform has grown in size and complexity, so has the opportunity to more consistently embed data into how we build and prioritize. Product Analytics exists to unlock that opportunity.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

About the job

About Nu

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 140 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To


Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.


What are we looking for?


Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

About the job

Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

Deel is transforming from a suite of products into an intelligent, orchestrated experience for work. As Principal Designer, you'll work directly with the Chief Design Officer as a collaborator on frontier design initiatives: the vision projects that sit ahead of where the core product roadmap is today. This is not a single-project role. The brief will move as the frontier moves. Right now, a central piece of that work is orchestration, designing what it means for a user to move from intent to resolution across a single, coherent experience layer.

Key Responsibilities


Design at the Frontier: Take early, undefined vision and turn it into designed, prototyped, shippable experience, anchored right now in orchestration and intent-to-resolution design, with the remit expanding to new frontier initiatives over time.
Build Across Verticals: Partner with product, engineering, and design leads across Deel's vertical teams so whatever you're building is coherent, scalable, and integrated with existing surfaces.

Build Alignment: Build alignment across product, engineering, and leadership through compelling design narrative and prototypes.
Raise the Bar on Craft: Hold a high craft bar on every surface you touch, sharp enough to stand next to brand without owning it.


Requirements


Principal or Staff Level Experience: 10+ years in design, including 2+ years at principal level - or equivalent seniority. You operate as an individual contributor in fast-paced, high-complexity product environments, leading through vision and craft, not people management.
Systems Thinker: Proven ability to design across product surfaces and organizational boundaries, thinking in systems, not screens.
Self-Directed: Comfortable owning a problem end to end with minimal oversight, from ambiguous brief to shipped experience, without waiting for direction on what to build next.
Comfortable with a Moving Brief: Energized by ambiguity and by work that shifts as the frontier moves, rather than needing a fixed, permanent mandate.
Prototyping and Craft: Exceptional prototyping skills and strong visual and interaction design sensibility.
AI-Native Design Practice: Hands-on experience designing AI-powered product experiences (agentic workflows, intent-driven interfaces, generative UI, personalization systems), focused on designing with and for AI rather than building AI tooling.
Personalization-Aware: Comfortable designing experiences powered by segmentation and personalization systems without owning the data modeling behind them.
Collaborative and Cross-functional: A natural relationship builder across design, product, and engineering who earns trust without needing a formal design-systems or data-science mandate to do it.
Communication and Narrative: An exceptional communicator who builds alignment through design vision, particularly when translating undefined ideas into something a room can align behind.
Location: NAMER or LATAM based, with working hours overlapping Pacific time and some overlap with EMEA.


Design and AI at Deel

AI is fundamentally changing what products can do and how they're designed. Right now, orchestration is Deel's most visible bet in this space, and it's where this role starts. But the mandate is broader than any single project: this is the design seat for whatever frontier the CDO is pushing next. If you've designed agentic workflows, intent-driven interfaces, generative UI, or personalization experiences, and you want a role where the brief keeps evolving rather than settling into steady-state, this is that seat.

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting


Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.


Customer Success & Escalation Management


Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.


Leadership & Process Improvement


Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.


What We Are Looking For


Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).
Technical Proficiency: Full understanding of job-related procedures and intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to provide clear, concise information using proper professional language.

Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.

Benefits

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).

This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity to support the digital media planning and execution of marketing communications across a diverse portfolio of Pepsico Mexico Foods brands. The role plays an important part in helping maximize the effectiveness of advertising and marketing investments through strong coordination, campaign management, and performance tracking.

We are looking for a proactive and organized individual with a foundational understanding of media and digital marketing. This role works closely with media agencies, as well as brand teams and extended areas to support the development, implementation, and optimization of media campaigns. Key responsibilities include managing day-to-day agency interactions, coordinating campaign deliverables and timelines, monitoring performance results, and supporting reporting and budget tracking activities.

As part of the broader marketing organization, the role provides hands-on support to ensure the right execution of media plans and alignment across stakeholders.

Your Impact

As Digital Media Coordinator Sr. your responsibilities would consist of:

Support the development and execution of Total Connections Planning strategies for the Pepsico Foods Mexico portfolio, ensuring alignment with brand objectives, campaign priorities and business goals.

Collaborate with Brand Teams, agencies and cross-functional stakeholders to support communication planning, media implementation and campaign activation across channels

Coordinate the development and execution of integrated media plans for brand campaigns, ensuring deliverables, timelines and stakeholders remain aligned throughout the process.

Assist in managing media investments by supporting budget tracking, campaign allocations and performance monitoring in partnership with internal teams and agency partners.

Monitor consumer, cultural and media trends and share relevant insights to help inform media recommendations and campaign planning.

Support the implementation of PepsiCo Total Connections Planning frameworks, tools and best practices across the portfolio.

Coordinate with brand teams and agency partners to support audience planning, personalization initiatives and channel activation efforts.

Work closely with local Media and regional teams to facilitate the adoption of media best practices, tools and new capabilities.

Maintain strong day-to-day relationships with media agencies, publishers and platform partners to ensure timely delivery of plans, assets and campaign requirements.

Consolidate campaign learnings, best practices and performance results, sharing key takeaways with stakeholders and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Assist in evaluating media recommendations and channel plans by reviewing performance data, campaign objectives and audience insights.

Support media planning and campaign management activities, including flowcharts, media plans, agency briefs and implementation tracking.

Manage day-to-day agency coordination, ensuring campaign deliverables are completed on time, meet quality standards and comply with PepsiCo processes and guidelines.

Track media productivity and efficiency initiatives, monitor results and support reporting against agreed targets and objectives.

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

Experience

Fluent in English.

3-5 years of experience in media planning, digital marketing, communications, campaign activation, media operations.

Experience working in a media agency and/or client-side organization. FMCG experience is a plus.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across brand teams, agencies, and cross-functional partners.

Foundational understanding of integrated communications planning, media strategy, and campaign execution across multiple channels.

Knowledge of the media ecosystem, including Digital, Retail Media, Out-of-Home, and emerging media channels.

Understanding of media planning and buying fundamentals, campaign delivery processes, and performance measurement principles.

Familiarity with digital marketing concepts, including audience targeting, media optimization, ad serving, campaign tracking, and media technologies.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign results, identify trends, and support data-driven recommendations.

Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve ways of working.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and matrixed environment while maintaining a collaborative and positive approach.

Experience supporting media planning, campaign management, performance reporting, or agency coordination activities is preferred.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

 Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

The role goes beyond standard attribution by incorporating incrementality, causal analysis, and second-order effects into investment decisions. You will work closely with Marketing, Data Engineering, Product, Sales, and Finance teams to improve measurement quality and optimize growth. You will also independently investigate data, uncover trends and anomalies, and turn complex findings into clear recommendations. This is a high-ownership role for an analytical leader who wants to directly influence marketing strategy, budget allocation, and sustainable growth.

Design, implement, and continuously refine attribution models across marketing channels to accurately reflect complex customer journeys.

Define and implement incrementality measurement approaches, including geo holdouts, intent-to-treat analyses, and synthetic controls.
Own attribution methodology decisions and clearly communicate the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different approaches.
Lead tracking infrastructure implementation, including pixels, tag management, and event tracking across web and mobile applications.
Design and maintain server-to-server integrations to improve signal quality, reduce data loss, and strengthen campaign optimization.

Independently extract, structure, and analyze data to answer business questions and move initiatives forward without relying on others for every analysis.
Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable visibility into campaign performance, channel ROI, and attribution trends.
Proactively identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities and translate findings into clear recommendations.
Use advanced analytics to connect marketing activity with business outcomes and inform budget allocation and channel mix decisions.
Partner with Performance and Lifecycle Marketing teams to translate measurement insights into campaign optimizations.
Conduct A/B and multivariate experiments to validate attribution assumptions and improve measurement accuracy.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines deep marketing analytics expertise with strong technical capabilities, business judgment, and the independence to own complex measurement initiatives from implementation through strategic recommendation.


5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related field.
Proven ability to independently manage complex, end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong technical expertise in tracking implementation, including GTM or equivalent tag management, pixel setup, web and mobile event tracking, and server-to-server integrations.
Deep knowledge of multi-touch, data-driven, and incrementality-based attribution models, including their limitations and appropriate use cases.

Experience with statistical modeling or machine learning applied to marketing, such as marketing mix modeling or propensity models, is a plus.
Experience mentoring junior analysts is desirable.

Strategic ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of attribution and marketing analytics initiatives.

Spearhead engagement with Corporate clients, actively marketing a diverse range of Natixis products, including Global Markets, DCM, syndications, corporate and project finance, trade finance, and more.
Contribute to the proactive monitoring of the client portfolio through strategic client dialogue, identifying visible transactions and mandates, and driving cross-sell opportunities with key clients.
Identify client financial needs and expertly coordinate with Natixis' dedicated teams to deliver optimal financial solutions.
Formulate and coordinate strategies with business lines, contributing significantly to strategic planning and operational development.
Collaborate with business lines and management for the preparation, monitoring, and reporting of budgets.
Originate and support New York-based product lines in the structuring and execution of transactions within Mexico.
Liaise effectively with New York's structuring and legal teams to facilitate transaction execution.
Coordinate and follow up on deal development with Operations and the New York LatAm Platform.
Ensure the proper onboarding and periodic review process for all client Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements.

Maintain high data quality within the Bank's systems to support the Credit Process, KYC, and monthly results reporting.

Assist the Senior Country Manager in ensuring the Representative Office remains compliant with local authorities' requirements and conditions, including timely submission of regulatory reports.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
Proven track record of strong relationship management skills and experience with corporate clients.

A proactive and positive attitude with a strong aptitude for learning and integrating into a dynamic team.
Language Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and proficiency in English, both written and verbal, is mandatory. French language skills are a significant advantage.
Technical Expertise: Proficiency in financial structuring, cash flow modeling, negotiation, due diligence, credit analysis, and project documentation.
Computer Proficiency: Advanced skills in software applications including Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, and PowerPoint.
Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional ability to present to clients and convey information clearly and comprehensively.
Teamwork: Ability to contribute effectively to collective organizational goals and to collaboratively solve problems and conflicts.
Decision Making: Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform problem analysis, gather data, identify solutions, exercise sound judgment, and make decisive actions.

A proactive and responsive approach to client needs, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.

A proactive and responsive approach to client needs, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.

description:
About the job

Description

Your Role

Gensler’s Brand Design team is all about making people feel happy, surprised, smart, confident, and important. We’re fun, talented, passionate, and excel at helping our clients enhance their brand and business performance. As a design firm, Gensler is committed to being client-first, diverse, exploratory, and sustainably minded.

As a mid-level designer, you will play a crucial role in driving creative projects, collaborating closely with clients, design teams, and other graphic designers. You are a hands-on designer with a passion for inspiring design and visual storytelling, capable of capturing and communicating a client’s brand essence and story using 2D and 3D applications.

What You Will Do 


Lead the design and delivery of the graphic/branding aspects of projects, from concept through execution.
Develop design concepts, layouts, and artwork, taking initiative and ownership of projects.
Provide strategic recommendations and creative solutions to meet client objectives.
Apply independent judgment in the evaluation, selection, and significant adaptation/modification of standard techniques and procedures.
Collaborate effectively with project consultant teams, ensuring cohesive project delivery.
Demonstrate a strong knowledge of graphic/brand design principles, graphic standards, technical details, codes, and material characteristics.
Produce creative print collateral, digital, and environmental solutions that resonate with target audiences.
Integrate brand messaging, color, imagery, type, and composition into cohesive deliverables.
Mentor junior designers and guide their professional development.
Interface with clients to present design concepts and progress updates, ensuring clear communication and alignment with client expectations.


Your Qualifications 


Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, environmental graphic design, information design, communication design, ora related field.
5+years of experience in a related field, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) and Microsoft Suite.
Strong interest or experience in UX and UI design is highly desired.
Exceptional illustration, typography, composition, and information design skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary, fast-paced environment.
Experience in visualizing ideas in two and three dimensions.
Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing brand experiences, especially as translated to built environments.
Excellent presentation and writing skills.
Preferred working knowledge of print production and fabrication, vendor management, signage, and wayfinding systems.


How To Apply

Submit an online application including a resume and portfolio in PDF form. If you choose to submit a link to an online portfolio, you must make sure it is not password protected and that it contains a resume, cover letter, and work samples.

Life at Gensler 

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include subsidized health and life insurance, annual bonus, LinkedIn learning, holiday observance, and employee assistance programs.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. We also reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under applicable regulatory laws.

Individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable regulatory laws.

Gensler endeavors to make gensler.com/careers accessible to all applicants. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us.

Regarding Gensler’s approach to recruiting new talent, we will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with Gensler to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing Gensler should email talentacquisition@gensler.com.

title: CRM Manager - Remote Work
description:
About the job

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




CRM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll own CRM execution for BairesDev's VIP Audiences & Experiences function, building and automating outreach sequences for our highest-value relationships across existing clients, former clients, and top-tier event audiences. Using Claude as your primary AI tool daily, you'll combine CRM expertise with generative AI fluency and automation workflows to generate measurable sales pipeline. This is an individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Director of VIP Audiences & Experiences, where your work translates directly into meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.




What You'll Do:




- Build and execute multi-touch outreach sequences across email, direct mail, and event follow-up for VIP account segments.

- Build and maintain AI-assisted automation workflows connecting outreach, CRM, and data enrichment tools.

- Use Claude as primary AI tool daily for outreach copy, contact research, account intelligence, and workflow logic.

- Track and report on pipeline outcomes including meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Own data enrichment workflows, keeping VIP contact records accurate, current, and actionable.




What we are looking for:




- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or outbound marketing.

- In-house experience at a US-based B2B company; agency or contractor work does not qualify.

- B2B SaaS or tech services industry experience.

- Hands-on experience with outreach automation platforms such as Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Reply.io, or equivalent.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI and LLM tools, with Claude strongly preferred; prompt engineering skills required.

- Experience with automation workflows using Zapier, n8n, or Make.com.

- Proficiency in a CRM platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.

- STEM or quantitative degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Physics; strong non-STEM candidates with a demonstrable data or numbers track record also considered.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Experience in B2B tech services, staffing, or nearshore companies.

- Experience marketing to C-suite or VP-level audiences.

- Background in marketing analytics, copywriting, or growth marketing.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
About the job

About Greystar

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

Job Description Summary

Works as part of a team to provide day-to-day management of the property and its community including marketing, building maintenance and tenancy administration and promotes and maintains an excellent resident experience in order to achieve occupancy and retention goals.

The annual base salary for this role starts from €26,571 depending on experience. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in on-site bonus programs.

Job Description

Key Role Responsibilities


Works as part of a team, supporting and respecting other team members, to deliver exceptional resident living. 
Supports the creation of a positive, memorable experience for residents
Delivers all aspects of customer service, including a comprehensive front of house service anticipating and exceeding resident expectations.

Supports events and activities within the Community

Completes administrative tasks including logging of maintenance requests, filing and preparing notices and updating of databases.

Carries out sales and leasing activities including: viewings, following up on enquiries and sales conversions. 
Assists with summer Community preparations, including move-in and move-out processes. 
Completes Health and Safety compliance activities in line with the Company’s policies and procedures. 
Participates where required in an on call roster to provide out of hours emergency support for the Community. 
Chase outstanding rent arrears following rent collection procedures in meeting property targets. 
Promote tenancy extensions and other revenue streams such as vending
Raise purchase orders in accordance with procedures
Ensure tenant refunds are completed in a timely manner and in line with Greystar’s policy.

Good level of general education

A knowledge and understanding of Health and Safety requirements and legislation


Essential

Experience & Skills


Excellent customer service skills and significant experience in a customer facing service delivery role.

One of Greystar’s core values is Equality, and as such, we pride ourselves on being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experience, even if you don't meet every requirement on the job advert.

Greystar is committed to having an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process.
